hooks.comment: Unified PreToolUse dispatcher (file tools) — reads official hook JSON from stdin. R1 backup-gate (Pre-Change Protocol: last commit must be [BACKUP]), R2 config-protection (CLAUDE.md/.claude/settings.json; bypass CLAUDE_CONFIG_EDIT_OK=1), R3 security reminder (delegates code files to security_reminder/security_reminder_hook.py; disable per session: ENABLE_SECURITY_REMINDER=0), R4 todo-diablo-gate (docs/TASK.md → todo-diablo-gate.sh). Fail-open on internal errors, logged to .claude/session-log/hook-errors.log. Script: .claude/hooks/dispatch.py

Unified PreToolUse dispatcher (Bash) — reads official hook JSON from stdin. R5 commit-prefix ([BACKUP|CHANGE|META|HANDOFF|PROCESS|RULES|SEC|FIX|WIP]), R6 task-id-validator (T-NNN requires docs/specs/T-NNN-*.md → task-id-validator.sh), R7 destructive-shell (rm -rf, git init/reset --hard/push --force/clean -fd, git rm on .claude|CLAUDE.md, broad git add -A/--all/. — bypass CLAUDE_ALLOW_BROAD_ADD=1; broad add has leaked secrets before), R8 destructive-SQL (DROP/TRUNCATE, DELETE without WHERE). Fail-open on internal errors, logged to .claude/session-log/hook-errors.log. Script: .claude/hooks/dispatch.py

Stop.comment: Final scan for console.log in project src dirs

hooks.command: bash -c 'GIT_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; found=$(grep -rn "console\.log" "$GIT_ROOT/src" "$GIT_ROOT/frontend/src" "$GIT_ROOT/app" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -5); [ -n "$found" ] && echo "$found" && echo "[STOP CHECK] console.log found — clean up before deploy" || true'

Stop.comment: Session log — append session entry for cost/activity tracking. ORDER: must run BEFORE the context-budget-enforce blocker below, because Stop hooks with exit 2 can short-circuit subsequent hooks and we want the audit trail preserved exactly when blocking happens.

hooks.command: bash -c 'GIT_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; LOG="$GIT_ROOT/.claude/session-log.jsonl"; COMMITS=$(git -C "$GIT_ROOT" log --since="4 hours ago" --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); FILES=$(git -C "$GIT_ROOT" diff --stat HEAD~${COMMITS:-1} 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -d " "); echo "{\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\",\"commits\":$COMMITS,\"summary\":\"$FILES\"}" >> "$LOG" 2>/dev/null; echo "[SESSION LOGGED] $COMMITS commits this session → .claude/session-log.jsonl"'

Stop.comment: Context budget HARD ENFORCEMENT — blocks Claude from stopping when real context % (from transcript) exceeds threshold AND handoff.md is stale/contentless. Exit 2 forces continuation. Thresholds overridable via CTX_BUDGET_* env vars. Circuit breaker prevents infinite loops. Tests: .claude/hooks/test-context-budget-enforce.sh. Must run BEFORE autopilot-backlog-guard below (that one is LAST).

AUTOPILOT backlog guard — when .claude/autopilot.flag exists, forces continuation (exit 2) until the agent emits AUTOPILOT-DONE/BLOCKED or the continue-cap (AUTOPILOT_CAP, default 25) is hit. Opt-in via flag file; fail-open; inert (never fires) unless the flag exists. LAST Stop hook. Script: .claude/hooks/autopilot-backlog-guard.sh

PreCompact.comment: Snapshot transcript before context compaction — audit-only, cannot block. Matcher omitted: fires on BOTH manual /compact and auto-compact per Claude Code hook docs. Sole writer of handoff rescue data (pre-compact-checkpoint.sh removed: three concurrent handoff.md writers conflicted). See .claude/hooks/pre-compact-snapshot.sh. Tests: .claude/hooks/test-pre-compact-snapshot.sh.
